title: One Thing Visible
pin_title: ADHD Screen: Keep Only One Task in Sight
description: Multiple open tabs and lists create noise that freezes action. Close everything except the single next step. When the brain sees only one thing, starting becomes lighter. Pair it with permission to stop when the timer ends. Clarity reduces friction more than motivation does. #ADHD #Focus #ADHDTips #OneThing
scene_prompt: A clean laptop screen showing one large soft card with a single star, soft room light, everything fully visible and brightly lit
